watch.summary: The streamer laughs as he recounts a chat message from a kid demanding to play Rocket League with him because he is his 'only viewer'.

beats.what: Streamer starts reading a chat message from a viewer.
Streamer counters that he has other viewers.
Streamer quotes the kid bluntly saying no one else is watching.
Streamer quotes the kid's ultimatium: 'What are you gonna do, just stream to nobody?'
Streamer admits the kid's hilarious logic was very compelling.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: What are you going to do, just stream to nobody?
watch.why: The viewer's absurdly bold guilt-trip attempt creates a funny moment that anyone familiar with internet culture can enjoy. The streamer's genuine amusement in retelling the story lands the punchline well.
